title: Illustration use / Large white headline on orange

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Give one statement visual priority so the viewer can grasp it before exploring the accompanying scene.
strategic_value: A large white headline on orange can make a Helsinki message emphatic while retaining illustrated warmth.
demonstration: Four lines of white placeholder headline dominate the left; a photographer-like figure, fire and winding boardwalk cluster at right.
practical_value: Use an asymmetrical headline-and-image split when the message needs immediate emphasis.

content_islands.name: Headline field
content_islands.spec: Set the four-line white headline across the left half of the orange background.

content_islands.name: Right-hand scene
content_islands.spec: Cluster the figure, fire and winding boardwalk on the right, allowing edge cropping.

reference_purposes.Application: The page combines a large statement with a compact illustration cluster.
reference_purposes.Expression: White text and orange ground create a strong contrast beside black, white and ochre motifs.
